title: Retrospective evaluation of an antimicrobial stewardship program in a tertiary care hospital: a pharmacist’s perspective
core_idea: Evaluate the impact of an antimicrobial stewardship program by analysing dose appropriateness, antibiotic consumption, surgical prophylaxis compliance, drug selection, and de-escalation of therapy based on culture and sensitivity through a retrospective review of medical records and consumption data across multiple hospital departments.
tldr: Retrospective assessment of an AMS program's prescribing and consumption practices across medicine, surgery, paediatrics, and orthopaedics using coded medical record data.
